name: ai-sources

frames.best_why: Fully expanded with all five source rows, icons and snippets readable, card at its tallest.

tagline: A tidy favicon stack under an answer opens into a list of cited sources.
summary: Three overlapping source icons and an overflow count sit under an AI answer. Clicking opens a list where each source's icon slides into its own row with a title and a short snippet.
appearance: A small inline control: three overlapping circular favicon chips, a +2 count, the word Sources and a chevron. Expanded, it becomes a column of rows, each with a round icon, a bold title and a grey snippet line, on a dark card.
behaviour: Hovering fans the stacked icons slightly apart; clicking expands the control into a list, the chevron turning to point down while each icon travels into its row and rows fade in one after another. A second click collapses it.
demo_content: A passage on dark oxygen at the seafloor and five citations about manganese nodules.
search_phrases: small overlapping website icons with count
research sources footnotes for ai reply
use_when: An AI answer or research summary must show its citations inline without pushing the prose off screen.
avoid_when: Only three icons show when collapsed, and long titles and snippets truncate, so a wide citation panel may fit better.
customise: Pass a sources array of id, title, url, snippet and an optional favicon node; label text and the default-open state are props. Row markup and timing need a source edit.
weight_why: A handful of spans and a height and opacity animation that runs only while opening.

a11y.note: Uses aria-expanded and real links, but the collapsed stack's letter tiles and +2 are read out before the label.

polish_why: Icon travel from stack to row is well staged; mid-open frames are briefly hard to read.
